our_interpretation: The ordinary reading concerns comparative US and Chinese generative-AI capabilities, rather than investment, revenue, or military power.
The continuation-of-trends proviso governs this forecast. It includes continued similarity in development approaches and reciprocal capability catch-up.
Minimal means a small practical capability advantage; short-lasting means an advantage competitors soon match. Marcus supplies neither a numerical threshold nor a duration.
The condition must be assessed independently of the predicted result. A capability gap alone cannot establish that the underlying development trends stopped.
No deadline or arbitrary number of months is added.
criteria.support_condition: While the stated development trends continue, successive independent evaluations show small practical capability gaps and prompt reciprocal catch-up. Such observations support the forecast over the observed period but cannot conclusively establish its unlimited future scope.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Independent evaluations establish a substantial, sustained national capability advantage while separate evidence establishes that the development trends covered by the proviso continued.
